summary: NFL selection-layer audit w1-w5 (225 graded refs, verifier-matched two ways): overall 117-106-2, -13.19u (-5.9% ROI). ML 45-29-1 (-3.62u); spread 41-33-1 (+5.11u, +6.8%); totals 31-44 (-14.68u, -19.6%) = the bleed. Overs 21-25 (-4.98u); unders 10-19 (-9.70u, -33.4%). UNDER loss anatomy: 16 of 19 losses actual beat line by double digits (avg +12.9, max +21.5); winners avg gap -3.5 vs losers -1.9 (deeper model-under gaps win, marginal ones get torched). No CFB-style big-fav overconfidence: spread |line|>=7 went 11-3-1 (+7.75u, taking side 9-2-1); ML 70-80% bucket 7/8, 80%+ 2/2; heavy favs (<=-300) 13-6 but -2.86u on short prices. Primetime fine (+2.38u, 23-19); divisional spreads drag 10-11 (-2.07u) vs non-div 31-22-1 (+7.19u). Injury pipeline only live in w5 (39 rows, 19-18-2, -3.41u) - too early to judge. Recs: (1) totals shrinkage - gate UNDERs on marginal gaps, recalibrate total_sd after shootout cluster; (2) protect spread-dog edge, esp big taking lines; (3) backtest divisional-spread discount + total-gap filter.
